name: Vertical Sprint
summary: Turns a character (uploaded reference or a newly generated athlete), a giant vertical structure, an aerial trick and a target model into one finished photorealistic text-to-video prompt for the viral Vertical Sprint format: an athlete sprints down a crowd corridor, runs straight up a 30-storey wall,
use_when: The user types "start", wants a vertical sprint, wall-run or mega-ramp run-up flip video, a "person runs up a giant wall and backflips" clip, a big extreme-sports event style stunt video, or wants to recreate this format with a new character, structure or trick for Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0, Kling or a similar video model.
produces: One finished, timestamped 15-second 9:16 photorealistic text-to-video prompt in a single copy-ready block (concept, character, environment, camera lock, timeline, physics rules, negatives), written for Seedance 2.5 or compacted under Wan 3.0's 5,000-character limit, plus a follow-up menu for variations.
